figures.name: eval-concurrency-throughput
figures.title: 并发扩展的完整批次完成速率
figures.caption: 固定 160 个 Workflow、两轮重访和相同资源，改变最大活跃 Workflow 数，横轴为 log2 刻度。完成速率为 160 除以完整批次时长，包含填充与排空；不是 SLO goodput。每个系统每点一次冻结算法模拟，无重复置信区间。
figures.caption_en: Fixed 160-workflow, two-visit workload; concurrency uses a log2 axis. Completion rate is 160 divided by full batch duration, including fill and drain; it is not SLO goodput. Each system has one frozen-algorithm simulation per point; no replicate confidence intervals.

figures.name: eval-failure-rate-throughput
figures.title: 固定时间窗口内的故障频率与完成速率
figures.caption: 预定 480 s 窗口内注入 K=0/1/2/4 次故障，横轴为 K/480 s 的每集群小时换算。三系统使用相同外部时刻与 GPU，每次不可用 120 s；窗口内停机暴露分别为 0/120/240/420 GPU·s，末次修复越过窗口。纵轴为窗口内完成数/480 s。此范围为压力扫描；每点每系统一次模拟。
figures.caption_en: K=0,1,2,4 external GPU failures in a prespecified 480-s window, expressed per cluster-hour. Systems share times and GPU targets; each outage lasts 120 s. In-window downtime is 0,120,240,420 GPU-s; the final repair extends beyond the window. The ordinate counts workflows completed by 480 s divided by 480 s. One simulation per system and stress point.
